decision.explanation: The question asks for the birth date of 'Porush' (referring to Meir Porush). The sources provide three conflicting dates for Meir Porush: '11 June 1955' (D1S1), '23 July 1960' (D2S1), and '11 June 1975' (D3S1). Per instructions to keep supported alternate referents and avoid silent equating of competing assertions, all three are retained. Dates for other individuals (Menachem Porush born 1916, Shlomo Zalman Porush born 1850) are excluded as they refer to different entities (father and ancestor).
